parent_objective: audit the task-quality decision panel and choose the next bounded paper-route branch
blocked_by: M2431 confirms 6/6 included measured panels are offtrack-dominated
M2431 preserves the c04 source-coverage gap
continuing source-linked local repair would ignore the task-quality blocker
supersedes: direct training or PPO from M2431
another source-linked local repair artifact before task-semantics reassessment
candidate/controller ranking from diagnostic panel rows

public_gates: M2432 must audit M2431 result_class and panel rows
M2432 must preserve that 6/6 included measured panels are offtrack-dominated
M2432 must preserve the c04 source-coverage gap
M2432 must choose task-semantics reassessment, source-coverage repair, high-fidelity/backend preparation, synthesis/stop, or bounded next evidence
M2432 must not rerun measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new measured rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not treat c04 as measured
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the cross-artifact task-quality panel and chooses whether to route to task-semantics reassessment or another bounded branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new measured rollout, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit treats M2431 as driver improvement
stop if the audit ranks candidates or controllers
stop if the audit hides c04 exclusion
stop if the audit routes to more source-linked local repair without task-quality reassessment
fallback_plan: route to task-semantics reassessment if repeated offtrack dominance is accepted
route to c04 source-coverage repair only if c04 is needed to diagnose task quality
route to high-fidelity/backend preparation if current-sim semantics are judged exhausted
stop for user review if no bounded route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: audit required after M2431 task-quality panel result

allowed_updates: M2432 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: audit accepts or rejects M2431 explicitly
offtrack-dominated repeated panel evidence is classified
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2432 audits task-quality outcomes and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2432; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repeated offtrack dominance is accepted, record the negative task-quality result and route to task-semantics reassessment before more local repair or training.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a cross-artifact task-quality panel rather than extending source-linked local repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide task-semantics reassessment route; cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2432 cannot select a clear bounded next route
another source-linked local repair is proposed without task-semantics reassessment
the task-quality branch accumulates additional artifact-only steps

hypothesis: Auditing M2431 will determine whether repeated offtrack dominance should route to task-semantics reassessment, source-coverage repair, high-fidelity/backend preparation, synthesis, or stop.
success_criteria: the audit accepts or rejects M2431 explicitly
repeated offtrack-dominated panel evidence is classified
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the branch is stopped
no measured rollout repair training ranking or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2432 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2432 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2432 passes if it audits M2431 task-quality evidence, preserves offtrack/c04 caveats, and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without measured rollout, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
